findings.title: Activate monitoring when a dataset is explicitly selected from neutral Quality
findings.trigger: Select Survey source, open generic Quality, expand imported files and click a monitoring dataset name/row.
findings.actual: Row and button only update selectedDatasetId. sourceMode remains survey, activeDataset remains null; aria-pressed is false, monitoring findings stay unavailable and Survey remains current source.
findings.expected: An explicit dataset selection activates monitoring and exposes that selected dataset and its quality findings, without any Runtime mutation.
findings.evidence: Private reviewer harness: baseline one pass; reviewed final HEAD one failure (aria-pressed expected true, actual false).
findings.recommendation: Use an explicit monitoring selection on both dataset row and named-button handlers; add a regression exercising Survey → generic Quality → dataset selection.
